content:

What is Azure Cost Optimization Recommendation Library (ACORL)?Mission StatementWelcome to the home of the Azure Cost Optimization Library (ACORL). The purpose of this site is to provide a curated catalog of cost optimization and cost governance recommendations for workloads running in Azure. Many of the recommendations contain supporting Azure Resource Graph (ARG) queries to help identify non-compliant resources.Get StartedTo get started head over to the Azure Resources section and then navigate to your chosen resource provider and resource type. Each of the listed resource types will provide recommendations, supporting documentation, and, when available, ARG queries.
